verdict.rationale: Convex's pricing page lists "Daily backups" as a plan feature, which covers automated backups. The CLI also offers `npx convex export` and `npx convex import` for moving data in and out of a deployment. There is no evidence of point-in-time recovery, and the backups are described only as a one-line pricing bullet with no detail on how restores work or how long backups are kept. missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, documented backup restore workflow, retention/frequency details beyond 'daily', independent or hands-on corroboration
